# Data governance and privacy

* **No real data in this repository.** All data here are synthetic, generated by
  `scripts/00_make_synthetic_ices.py`. `data/` is git-ignored.
* Before any ICES record is accessed: institutional ethics approval (or documented
  exemption/determination), ICES approvals, and all data-use agreements.
* All record-level work happens inside the approved secure environment, with
  least-privilege access. No individual-level records are exported.
* Only aggregate output that has passed the custodian's disclosure-control review
  leaves the environment (e.g. small-cell suppression per ICES rules).
* Confirm with ICES whether custom Python/R/Stan code can run and which versions are
  installed (SAP section 10). The SAS template in `sas/` is the fallback for cohort
  construction.
* Public artefacts (this repository, the released package) use synthetic data only.
